description.p: Mizuki is a fast, native anime image browser for the Linux desktop. Search multiple booru sources, filter by tags and rating, preview artwork, and download your favourites in one click.

ul.li: Modular sources including Danbooru, Safebooru, Konachan, Yande.re and Zerochan
Tag search with suggestions, source filters and SFW controls
Responsive artwork grid with a Material You-inspired accent palette
Background downloads with a live progress queue
Favourites and custom sources loaded from a plugin folder

description.p: Mizuki is not affiliated with any of the image boards it connects to. Artwork belongs to the original artists.
Initial release with five modular sources, tag search, favourites and downloads.
